@runtimes [:offline_island]
@lifecycles [:started, :replayed, :stopped, :blocked]
@outcomes [:accepted, :rejected, :conflict, :blocked]
@denials [:none, :scope_inactive, :sigra_denied, :route_denied, :feature_denied]

@enforce_keys @replay_keys ++ @doctor_keys
defmodule Error do
  @enforce_keys [:rule_id, :path]
  defstruct [:rule_id, :path]
end

@type projection :: %{required(atom()) => atom() | non_neg_integer() | String.t()}
@spec new(map()) :: {:ok, t()} | {:error, Error.t()}
def new(attrs) when is_map(attrs) and not is_struct(attrs) do
  with :ok <- exact_atom_keys(attrs),
       :ok <- route(attrs.route_id),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.runtime, @runtimes, :runtime),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.lifecycle, @lifecycles, :lifecycle),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.outcome, @outcomes, :outcome),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.denial, @denials, :denial),
       :ok <- measurements(attrs.measurements),
       :ok <- readiness(attrs.configuration, :configuration),
       :ok <- readiness(attrs.adapter_readiness, :adapter_readiness) do
    {:ok, struct!(__MODULE__, attrs)}
  end
end

def new(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

@spec validate(t()) :: {:ok, t()} | {:error, Error.t()}
def validate(%__MODULE__{} = observation) do
  observation |> Map.drop([:__struct__]) |> new()
end

def validate(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

@spec to_telemetry(t()) :: {:ok, projection()} | {:error, Error.t()}
def to_telemetry(%__MODULE__{} = observation) do
  with {:ok, observation} <- validate(observation) do
    {:ok,
     %{
       route_id: observation.route_id,
       runtime: observation.runtime,
       lifecycle: observation.lifecycle,
       outcome: observation.outcome,
       denial: observation.denial
     }
     |> Map.merge(observation.measurements)}
  end
end

def to_telemetry(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

@spec to_logger(t()) :: {:ok, projection()} | {:error, Error.t()}
def to_logger(observation) do
  to_telemetry(observation)
end

@spec to_doctor(t()) ::
        {:ok, %{configuration: atom(), adapter_readiness: atom()}} | {:error, Error.t()}
def to_doctor(%__MODULE__{} = observation) do
  with {:ok, observation} <- validate(observation) do
    {:ok,
     %{configuration: observation.configuration, adapter_readiness: observation.adapter_readiness}}
  end
end

def to_doctor(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

defp exact_atom_keys(attrs) do
  if Map.keys(attrs) |> MapSet.new() == MapSet.new(@replay_keys ++ @doctor_keys) do
    :ok
  else
    error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-KEY", :input)
  end
end

defp route(value) when is_binary(value) do
  if value =~ ~r/\Aroute-[0-9a-f]{16}\z/ do
    :ok
  else
    error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-ROUTE", :route_id)
  end
end

defp route(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-ROUTE", :route_id)
end

defp enum(value, allowed, path) do
  if value in allowed do
    :ok
  else
    error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-VALUE", path)
  end
end

defp measurements(values) when is_map(values) and not is_struct(values) do
  valid? =
    Map.keys(values) |> Enum.all?(&(&1 in @measurements)) and
      Enum.all?(values, fn {_key, value} ->
        is_integer(value) and value >= 0 and value <= 1_000_000
      end)

  if valid? do
    :ok
  else
    error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-MEASUREMENT", :measurements)
  end
end

defp measurements(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-MEASUREMENT", :measurements)
end

defp readiness(value, _path)
     when value in [:configured, :unconfigured, :ready, :blocked, :unavailable] do
  :ok
end

defp readiness(_, path) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-READINESS", path)
end

defp error(rule_id, path) do
  {:error, %Error{rule_id: rule_id, path: path}}
end

@doctor_keys [:configuration, :adapter_readiness]
@runtimes [:offline_island]
@lifecycles [:started, :replayed, :stopped, :blocked]
@outcomes [:accepted, :rejected, :conflict, :blocked]
@denials [:none, :scope_inactive, :sigra_denied, :route_denied, :feature_denied]
@measurements [:attempt_count, :event_count, :duration_ms]
@enforce_keys @replay_keys ++ @doctor_keys
defstruct @enforce_keys

  @enforce_keys [:rule_id, :path]
  defstruct [:rule_id, :path]
end

@type projection :: %{required(atom()) => atom() | non_neg_integer() | String.t()}
@spec new(map()) :: {:ok, t()} | {:error, Error.t()}
def new(attrs) when is_map(attrs) and not is_struct(attrs) do
  with :ok <- exact_atom_keys(attrs),
       :ok <- route(attrs.route_id),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.runtime, @runtimes, :runtime),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.lifecycle, @lifecycles, :lifecycle),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.outcome, @outcomes, :outcome),
       :ok <- enum(attrs.denial, @denials, :denial),
       :ok <- measurements(attrs.measurements),
       :ok <- readiness(attrs.configuration, :configuration),
       :ok <- readiness(attrs.adapter_readiness, :adapter_readiness) do
    {:ok, struct!(__MODULE__, attrs)}
  end
end

  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

def validate(%__MODULE__{} = observation) do
  observation |> Map.drop([:__struct__]) |> new()
end

def validate(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

@spec to_telemetry(t()) :: {:ok, projection()} | {:error, Error.t()}
def to_telemetry(%__MODULE__{} = observation) do
  with {:ok, observation} <- validate(observation) do
    {:ok,
     %{
       route_id: observation.route_id,
       runtime: observation.runtime,
       lifecycle: observation.lifecycle,
       outcome: observation.outcome,
       denial: observation.denial
     }
     |> Map.merge(observation.measurements)}
  end
end

def to_telemetry(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

@spec to_logger(t()) :: {:ok, projection()} | {:error, Error.t()}

  to_telemetry(observation)
end

  with {:ok, observation} <- validate(observation) do
    {:ok,

  end
end

  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-INPUT", :input)
end

  end
end

  end
end

defp route(_) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-ROUTE", :route_id)
end

defp enum(value, allowed, path) do

    :ok
  else
    error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-VALUE", path)
  end
end

defp measurements(values) when is_map(values) and not is_struct(values) do

  end
end

  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-MEASUREMENT", :measurements)
end

defp readiness(_, path) do
  error("CW-SAFE-OBSERVATION-READINESS", path)
end

defp error(rule_id, path) do
  {:error, %Error{rule_id: rule_id, path: path}}
end
